documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS
Clarification sought from Oracle Financial Services Software Ltd
Intimation Of Grant Of Options Under OFSS Stock Plan 2014

analysis.summary: Oracle Financial Services Software Limited reported consolidated revenues of 76,721 million and net income of 26,393 million for the financial year 2025-26, representing year-on-year increases of 12% and 11% respectively. The Board declared two interim dividends totaling 400 per share for the financial year. Management highlighted accelerated investments and advancements in Artificial Intelligence and cloud solutions, which are reshaping the company's operating model and product portfolio. The company maintained a strong operating margin of 44% and net margin of 34%, supported by consistent operational efficiency and financial discipline. Oracle Financial Services Software Limited reported consolidated revenues of 68.5 billion, growing 7% over the previous financial year, with a net income of 23.8 billion and a net margin of 35%.

demand_outlook.claim: The Chairperson noted that the business landscape was driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges, and shifting technology trends leading to demand challenges in the industry.
demand_outlook.quote: During the financial year, the business landscape continued to be driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges and shifting technology trends - all leading to demand challenges in the industry.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an operating margin of 44% reflecting consistent focus on execution and operational efficiency.
margins_costs.quote: We also continued to maintain strong financial discipline, resulting in an operating margin of 44%, reflecting the Company's consistent focus on execution and operational efficiency.

margins_costs.claim: The net margin remained strong at 34% for the financial year.
margins_costs.quote: Net income rose to ₹ 26.4 billion, reflecting an 11% increase year-on-year, while the net margin remained strong at 34%.

margins_costs.claim: The operating margin for the financial year rose to 44% compared to 42% in the last financial year.
margins_costs.quote: We continued to maintain a strong financial discipline while driving the growth, and our operating margin for the financial year rose to 44% as compared to 42% in the last financial year.

orders_capacity.claim: The Company signed a number of multi-million dollar deals with marquee customers across the world.
orders_capacity.quote: Your Company signed a number of multi-million dollar deals with marquee customers across the world which are a testimony to the excellence of our products through continuing R&D, our track record of delivering high quality implementations, and providing reliable support.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved two interim dividends totaling 400 per share for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board approved two interim dividends totaling ₹ 400 per share for FY 2025-26.

capital_allocation.claim: The company issued and allotted 172,032 equity shares of face value of 5 each to employees and Directors upon exercise of stock options.
capital_allocation.quote: During the financial year 2025-26, the Company issued and allotted 172,032 equity shares of face value of ₹ 5 each to the employees and Directors of the Company and its subsidiaries who exercised their stock options under the prevailing Employee Stock Option Scheme of the Company.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved an interim dividend of 265 per equity share for the financial year ended March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company ("the Board") declared an interim dividend of ₹ 265 per equity share of ₹ 5 each on April 25, 2025, for the financial year ended March 31, 2025.

risks_headwinds.claim: The business landscape during the financial year was driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges, and shifting technology trends.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the financial year, the business landscape continued to be driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges and shifting technology trends - all leading to demand challenges in the industry.

management_commitments.claim: The Company remains committed to delivering sustainable value, pioneering innovation, and maintaining the highest standards of governance.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to delivering sustainable value, pioneering innovation and maintaining the highest standards of governance.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
